payload.description: Add time-boxed, measurable fixes for intent-state misalignment with A/B testing frameworks
user_stories: As a developer, I want to track intent-state alignment within time frames to prioritize fixes.
As a product manager, I need measurable outcomes from A/B tests to validate alignment improvements.
As a tester, I require integration with existing A/B frameworks to validate changes.
open_questions: Which A/B frameworks should be prioritized for integration?
How to handle overlapping time-boxed experiments?
What metrics will define 'success' for each alignment fix?
success_metrics: Reduced intent-state misalignment by 40% within 3 months.
A/B test coverage of 100% for critical alignment paths.
Average resolution time for misalignment issues reduced by 50%.
payload.problem_statement: Current intent-state alignment lacks time-bound metrics and A/B testing integration, leading to unresolved misalignment issues.
payload.proposed_solution: Implement a framework for time-boxed fixes with A/B testing to measure effectiveness.
technical_requirements: Integrate with existing A/B testing platforms (e.g., Optimizely, Google Experiments).
Implement time-bound tracking for intent-state alignment.
Expose metrics via API for real-time monitoring.

failure_reason: Binding veto: VETO: Proposed solution lacks explicit risk mitigation for overlapping time-boxed experiments. FIX: Add automated conflict detection in the A/B testing integration framework.
